# Obed Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old at the beginning of the series  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P8](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0008), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley, St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c3 P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030)</sub>

## Appearance

Obed is an unusual-appearing man with an awkward, hunching frame and lengthy iron-gray hair reaching his shoulders. He wears a thick, gentle brown beard that he has kept on his face continuously since the age of twenty. On formal occasions, he wears a white collar alongside his finest suit of clothes.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Obed is an exceptionally timid, bashful, and quiet man who despises being surrounded by unfamiliar people or visiting places where he must converse. He holds a deep fear of women, feeling uneasy and believing they quietly mock him, with the exception of his sister Thirza and neighbor Agatha Sowerby. Despite his bashfulness, he enjoys loquacious companions provided they handle the conversation entirely themselves. He possesses a quiet, stubborn determination when he fixes his heart on a decision.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021)_

## Goals

- To keep and adopt Nell at Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c3 P55](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0055), [v1 c3 P61](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0061), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021)</sub>
- To provide Nell with a good home and education  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c25 P60](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0060)</sub>

## History

Obed Abernethy lived as a quiet farmer at Grey Shutters in Brierley alongside his unmarried sister, Thirza. Sometime after discussing his need for farm help, he traveled to Alder River to collect an orphan boy sent from Nova Scotia, only to discover that an orphan girl named Nell Harcourt had been delivered by mistake. Unable to leave her behind, he brought Nell to Grey Shutters and quickly grew fond of her loquacious nature, stubbornly persuading Thirza to allow her to remain. He formed a deep bond with Nell, secretly comforting her during her punishments, buying her treats, and later gifting her a stylish dress for Christmas. Over the years, Obed's health deteriorated due to worsening heart trouble, though he continued working on the farm. Tragically, upon receiving news that the Abbey Bank holding all of their life savings had failed, Obed suffered a sudden, fatal shock and collapsed in the doorway of Grey Shutters.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c3 P61](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0061), [v1 c10 P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013), [v1 c12 P43](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0043), [v1 c25 P33](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0033), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038), [v1 c37 P0](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0000), [v1 c37 P8](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0008), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)_

- Raised in Brierley by a father who was as bashful and quiet as himself  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>

- Supporter of the Conservative political party  <sub>[v1 c18 P9](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0009)</sub>
